detail.longDescription: Work Inbox is an open-source workspace for teams that runs on Cloudflare Workers. It covers email on your own domain (with IMAP/SMTP for mail apps), team chat, shared notes, a calendar, a drive and contacts in one app. You can self-host it on your own Cloudflare account or use the hosted version at workinbox.io. I created it because i have few small project that have their own mails and administering of that was hard. Feel free to give feedback!
